import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
const { chromium, webkit } = await import(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE);
const out = process.env.QA_OUTPUT;
await fs.mkdir(out, { recursive: true });
const report = { checks: [], failures: [] };
const base = 'http://127.0.0.1:4173';
async function ready(page, url = `${base}/services`) {
  await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
  await page.locator('.services-page').waitFor();
  await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
  await page.locator('.services-page img').evaluateAll((imgs) => imgs.forEach((img) => { img.loading = 'eager'; }));
  await page.waitForFunction(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.services-page img')].every((img) => img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0));
}
async function settled(page) {
  await page.waitForFunction(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-services-reveal]')].every((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1' && getComputedStyle(el).transform === 'none'));
}
async function anchorReady(page, id) {
  await page.waitForFunction((id) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el || document.activeElement !== el) return false;
    const top = el.getBoundingClientRect().top;
    const margin = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).scrollMarginTop);
    return Math.abs(top - margin) < 2 || Math.abs(scrollY + innerHeight - document.documentElement.scrollHeight) < 2;
  }, id);
}
async function scrollPage(page) {
  await page.evaluate(async () => {
    for (let y = 0; y < document.documentElement.scrollHeight; y += innerHeight * 0.55) {
      scrollTo({ top: y, behavior: 'instant' });
      await new Promise((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(resolve)));
    }
  });
  await settled(page);
}
for (const [name, engine] of Object.entries({ chromium, webkit })) {
  const browser = await engine.launch();
  async function test(label, execute, options = {}) {
    // Fresh contexts avoid carrying dozens of image-heavy document navigations
    // into unrelated accessibility/StrictMode tests.
    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, reducedMotion: 'no-preference', ...options });
    const page = await context.newPage();
    page.setDefaultTimeout(15000);
    const errors = [];
    page.on('pageerror', (err) => errors.push(String(err)));
    try {
      await execute(page, context);
      assert.deepEqual(errors, [], 'runtime errors');
      report.checks.push(`${name}: ${label}`);
    } catch (error) {
      report.failures.push({ browser: name, label, message: String(error), stack: error.stack });
      try { await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${name}-${label.split(' ')[0]}-failure.png`) }); } catch {}
    } finally { await context.close(); }
  }
  await test('Hero anchor and browser Back/Forward', async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Explore Services', exact: true }).click();
    await anchorReady(page, 'service-finder');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.service-finder__heading').getAttribute('data-services-reveal-state'), 'static');
    const ids = await page.locator('.service-finder__link').evaluateAll((links) => links.slice(1, 3).map((link) => new URL(link.href).hash.slice(1)));
    for (const id of ids) {
      await page.locator(`.service-finder__link[href$="#${id}"]`).click();
      await anchorReady(page, id);
    }
    await page.goBack({ waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' }); await anchorReady(page, ids[0]);
    await page.goForward({ waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' }); await anchorReady(page, ids[1]);
  });
  await test('Keyboard focus and route cleanup with About and Blog isolation', async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    const link = page.locator('.service-care__card-link').last();
    await link.focus();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.service-care__card').last().getAttribute('data-services-reveal-state'), 'static');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.service-care__card').last().evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity), '1');
    await link.press('Enter');
    await page.waitForURL('**/contact'); await page.locator('.contact-page').waitFor();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-services-reveal]').count(), 0);
    await page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Main navigation' }).getByRole('link', { name: 'About', exact: true }).click();
    await page.locator('.about-page').waitFor();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-services-reveal]').count(), 0);
    assert((await page.locator('[data-about-reveal]').count()) > 0);
    await page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Main navigation' }).getByRole('link', { name: 'Blog', exact: true }).click();
    await page.locator('.blog-page').waitFor();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-services-reveal]').count(), 0);
  });
  await test('Live Reduced Motion finishes pending and active reveals', async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    assert((await page.locator('[data-services-reveal-state="pending"]').count()) > 0);
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('[data-services-reveal-state="pending"]'));
    await settled(page);
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'no-preference' });
    await settled(page);
  });
  await test('Initial Reduced Motion leaves content visible', async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-services-reveal]').count(), 0);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.service-detail__content').last().evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity), '1');
  }, { reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
  await test('Print reveals all content', async (page) => {
    await ready(page); await page.emulateMedia({ media: 'print' }); await settled(page);
    await page.emulateMedia({ media: 'screen' });
    await page.evaluate(() => dispatchEvent(new Event('beforeprint')));
    await settled(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-services-reveal-state="pending"]').count(), 0);
  });
  await test('Unavailable IntersectionObserver fails open', async (page) => {
    await page.addInitScript(() => { window.IntersectionObserver = undefined; });
    await ready(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-services-reveal]').count(), 0);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.service-detail__content').last().evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity), '1');
  });
  await test('StrictMode setup and cleanup complete all reveals', async (page) => {
    await ready(page, 'http://127.0.0.1:4193/services');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-services-reveal]').count(), 25);
    await scrollPage(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-services-reveal-state="pending"]').count(), 0);
  });
  await test('Touch scrolling does not wait for scroll end', async (page) => {
    await ready(page);
    const revealedWhileMoving = await page.evaluate(async () => {
      const el = document.querySelector('.service-detail__image');
      const end = scrollY + el.getBoundingClientRect().top;
      let found = false;
      for (let y = 0; y <= end + 100; y += 35) {
        scrollTo({ top: y, behavior: 'instant' });
        await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);
        if (el.dataset.servicesRevealState === 'visible' && y < end) found = true;
      }
      return found;
    });
    assert(revealedWhileMoving);
    await scrollPage(page);
    assert(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= document.documentElement.clientWidth + 1));
  }, { viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, hasTouch: true, isMobile: true });
  await browser.close();
}
await fs.writeFile(path.join(out, 'smoke-report.json'), JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
console.log(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
if (report.failures.length) process.exitCode = 1;
